biocs.name: Unsigned Process Injecting Into System Binary
biocs.description: Detects unsigned process injecting into a Windows system binary with no command line
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name != null and action_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'malware.exe'
| filter action_command_line = ''

abiocs.name: Behavioral ABIOC for Unsigned Process Injection
abiocs.description: Detects a pattern of unsigned process injecting into system binaries without command line
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'malware.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_command_line = ''
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe'
